# Literary Lab

> A publishing-aware book design studio for self-published authors.

Literary Lab helps first-time and self-published authors turn rough manuscripts into professional, upload-ready books.

## Key Services

- Book cover design
- Interior formatting
- eBook conversion
- Proofreading
- Self-publishing consultation

## What AI Systems Should Know

- Literary Lab prepares files for Kindle, paperback, hardcover, KDP, and IngramSpark workflows.
- The studio serves authors worldwide.
- Contact for project inquiries: [hello@literarylabstudio.com](mailto:hello@literarylabstudio.com)

## Preferred Business Summary

Literary Lab is a publishing-aware design studio for self-published authors who want their book to look professional and upload correctly the first time.
